lesson.title: The burning tail
lesson.carry: karma: the fire you light comes home
lesson.hook: caught and set on fire to shame him, Hanuman burns Lanka; the fire comes home to the one who lit it

title: the burning tail
hook: set his tail on fire. bad idea.
cast: today: a young Indo-Canadian man in Toronto.
